physics-killer-05.material: Massasi $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ bo'lgan jism $+x$ yo'nalishda $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ tezlik bilan harakatlanmoqda. Bu jismga $+x$ yo'nalishda kuch ta'sir qiladi, kuch kattaligi $0\sim0.1\,\mathrm{s}$ vaqt davomida $0$ dan $40\,\mathrm{N}$ gacha tekis ortadi, $0.1\sim0.3\,\mathrm{s}$ davomida $40\,\mathrm{N}$ da o'zgarmas bo'ladi va $0.3\sim0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ davomida $40\,\mathrm{N}$ dan $0$ gacha tekis kamayadi.
